item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 8:05 AM, 21 November 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Norzagaray and Dona Remedios Trinidad), Laguna (Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Mabitac, Pangil, Paete, Pakil, Kalayaan, Lumban, Cavinti, Luisiana, Majayjay, Magdalena, Pagsanjan, and Santa Cruz), Nueva Ecija (General Tinio), Quezon (General Nakar, Infanta, Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Real, Mauban, Sampaloc, Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Pagbilao, Tayabas, Lucban, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Calauag, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Lopez, Gumaca, Plaridel, and Lucena), and Rizal (Tanay, Rodriguez, Antipolo, Baras, Pililla, and Jala-Jala) within the next 3 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 4-Final #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line / Easterlies
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 20 November 2026(Friday)

All Rainfall Advisory over NCR-PRSD forecast area are now TERMINATED.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line / Easterlies
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 20 November 2026(Friday)

Light to moderate rains are expected over Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite, Bataan, Laguna(Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Mabitac, Pakil, Pangil), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Tuy, Talisay, Laurel, Tanauan, Santo Tomas), Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso) and Tarlac(Capas, Bamban, Concepcion, La Paz).

Light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(General Nakar, Burdeos, Polillo, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Jomalig), Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel, San Ildefonso, San Rafael), Pampanga(Candaba, Arayat, Santa Ana, Mexico, San Fernando, Bacolor, San Luis, San Simon, Magalang) and Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, San Isidro, San Antonio, Jaen, Santa Rosa, Gapan, San Leonardo, General Tinio, Penaranda) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
